page.overview:
Who is Alberto?

Alberto is the husband of Sylvia and the father of Ruthie.

He and Sylvia met at Kozy Kabins after Alberto took Marge there for the night and Sylvia took Homer there for the night, despite Marge and Homer both being married to each other.

Throughout the episode the character acts very flamboyant but is apparently straight. When Homer sees Marge's silhouette through the cabin window, Marge tells Alberto to hide in a chest at the end of the bed.

Homer drags the chest outside and when he sees Sylvia he stuffs her in the chest as well, resulting in Alberto and Sylvia meeting. Five years on and it's the present day.
